# Muhammad Ali Sajid — Shopify Developer & AFA

> Muhammad Ali Sajid is a Shopify Developer, Founder of Creatify, and Affiliate Financial Accountant (AFA) from Multan, Pakistan. He builds custom Shopify storefronts for fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. He is also pursuing a BS Accounting & Finance degree at Bahauddin Zakariya University (BZU) Multan and progressing toward full CMA (Certified Management Accountant) certification (17 papers completed).

## Shopify Projects (26 Stores)

Notable international clients:
- [Maje (maje.ae)](https://www.maje.ae/): Luxury Parisian womenswear, UAE market. Fully customized Dawn theme with editorial mega menu.
- [Rhode Skin (rhodeskin.com)](https://www.rhodeskin.com/): Hailey Bieber's DTC beauty brand. Custom theme with cream tones, autoplay videos, early access gates.
- [Caliphe Clothing (calipheclothing.com)](https://calipheclothing.com/): Pakistani activewear. Dawn theme with full-width autoplay hero.

Other Shopify stores span fashion, beauty, skincare, fragrance, footwear, coffee, home decor, kitchen, pet, outdoor, bags, tech, and more. Clients include Briogeo, Meow Meow Tweet, Magic Mind, Chamberlain Coffee, Snif, Kate & Kole, Wild One, Sunday Citizen, Our Place, Negative Underwear, Lalo, Parks Project, Bellroy, Native Union, Kotn, Allbirds, Gharyal, Nureh, Manto, Conatural, Optic World, Iron Gear, Raaz, Vessi.

## Tools & Apps

- [Zakatly](https://zakatly-beta.vercel.app/): Free, open-source Zakat calculator. Nisab setup (gold/silver), multi-currency (PKR, USD, SAR, AED, GBP, EUR+), cash, investments, business assets, liabilities. Offline PWA. Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Vite. [GitHub](https://github.com/alibhatti23/zakatly)
